selection.method: Deterministic stratified selection from supported rows; 50% India and 50% worldwide, then proportional country/geographic-level quotas and systematic positions within each stratum.

metrics.nearDuplicateMethod: Same-country and same-geographic-level comparisons, at most 20 evenly distributed peers per generated page; threshold 80% normalized token similarity.
metrics.qualityScoreDefinition: The existing location content composer quality score (0-100); unresolved/rejected records score 0.
metrics.differentiationScoreDefinition: 100 minus the maximum normalized token similarity against same-country/geographic-level peers. Differentiation aggregates and the lowest-score examples include only successfully generated pages; records without generated content receive quality score 0 but are not assigned a differentiation score.
